free_tier.stated: No free plan is listed in the plan block; the page opens directly at '1 Month €17.95 - 1 TB Storage - 35GB/Daily Bandwidth'.
free_tier.notes: An account is free to create ('Create Account'), but every listed plan is paid and the daily bandwidth figure is part of the paid plan.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the page read

retention.stated: not stated on the page read

egress.terms: Each plan carries the same '35GB/Daily Bandwidth', which is a download allowance rather than a throttle. 35 GB/day is about 1.05 TB per 30 days.

interface_detail: Web upload and share. The page lists no API, FTP or remote-upload path.
tooling: Browser only as read. Leechall lists emload with a 250 MB/day cap, the smallest on that list, so a leecher is not a practical substitute.
chaining: One of the Korean-market hosts ('Webhard') that hold releases which never appear on the Western hosts. 35 GB/day covers a 1 TiB month only if the month is exactly 30 days of full use, so it is a top-up rather than a bulk path.

limits.value: 35 GB per day of download bandwidth on every plan
1 TB of storage on every plan

limits_note: The daily bandwidth is identical across 1-month, 3-month, 6-month and 1-year plans; only the price per day changes. Nothing on the page suggests the allowance scales with price.
binding_note: 35 GB/day is the hard wall: a 1 TiB month needs 34.1 GB/day sustained, which leaves 0.9 GB/day of headroom and no room for a retry. The 1 TB storage figure is the same number as the monthly transfer, so both walls arrive together.

identity_cost.detail: Account creation is free; premium is bought at checkout. The page does not state which card processors are used, and the signup form fields were not read.

reliability_note: A bandwidth counter that resets daily means an unused day is lost, and a plan that runs at 35 GB/day exactly has no margin for a re-download.
confidence_note: Price and plan terms read on the vendor page today. The Korea-specific host list and the real per-file cap are not in this record.

evidence.proved: the plan block: 1 Month €17.95, 3 Months €43.95, 6 Months €70.95, 1 Year €107.95, each with '1 TB Storage' and '35GB/Daily Bandwidth'
a third-party leecher's cap for the host: 'emload.com 0 B / 250 MB /d'

price_per_tb_month: EUR 17.95 per month for 1 TB stored and 35 GB/day
notes: Kshared publishes the identical plan at the identical price ('1 Month €17.95, 1 TB Storage, 35GB/Daily Bandwidth', 'Choose Your CloudFLA Plan'), which is one operator or one white-label script. The annual plan is €107.95, or €8.99 a month.
